channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jermaine O'Neal | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jermaine O'Neal from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Roy Hibbert, Jermaine O'Neal, Rik Smits, Myles Turner
item.description:
Alex Golden:Tyrese Haliburton on recording 3 blocks in a game for the 3rd time this season:

“I appreciate that Alex, thank you for recognizing that…so it goes: Myles Turner, Rik Smits, Jermaine O’Neal, Roy Hibbert, Tyrese Haliburton. That’s how it’s gonna end when I’m done here…but in my mindset, I’m the 5th best shot blocker in franchise history and you can’t tell me different.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Roy Hibbert, Jermaine O'Neal, Rik Smits, Myles Turner, Apr 11, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Corey Benjamin on Tracy McGrady, Jermaine O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Jerry Krause
item.description:
Corey Benjamin:

“I had Arn Tellem as an agent and Arn represented a lot of star players. The Bulls were trying to sign free agents. I hosted Tracy McGrady, Tim Thomas and Jermaine O’Neal when we brought them in. I was there personally for those [meetings] because we were all represented by the same agent (Arn).I remember Jerry Krause told me, ‘If you can get them to sign, I’ll renew your contract.’ I don’t remember Tim Duncan coming in, but I know we wanted Duncan. But we weren’t offering them the money that other teams were offering. I remember Tracy and Jermaine telling me, ‘They’re offering me peanuts.’They weren’t trying to max these guys out; they were trying to give these guys smaller contracts.”

Corey Benjamin on Tracy McGrady, Jermaine O'Neal, Tim Duncan, Jerry Krause, May 18, 2020. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
And on media day, he said something that made observers truly roll their eyes.

“Obviously, the main leader in the locker room is Jermaine O'Neal, who is already in charge of everything,”

Marcin Gortat on Jermaine O'Neal, Oct 11, 2012. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Kendrick Perkins, Nate Robinson, Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“The team with Shaq, Bib Baby, Kendrick Perkins, Jermaine O'Neal, Nate Robinson... That was probably the most fun I've had since I've been in the league... That team was a character. [...] There was never a dull moment in that locker room. I wish we got Shaq earlier in his career... That was a cool team.”

Kevin Garnett on Kendrick Perkins, Nate Robinson, Jermaine O'Neal, Sep 10, 2012. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
Ainge on Jermaine O'Neal returning for the 2011-12 season:

“He has every intention of coming back. I wouldn’t say -- something could happen that he won’t come back -- but I think... he has every desire to come back and play, and didn’t like the way it finished this year. He doesn’t want to end his career on that kind of note, he wants to be a much bigger contributor next year.”

Danny Ainge on Jermaine O'Neal, Jun 22, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
Danny Ainge, Boston's president of basketball operations, confirmed to CSNNE.com on Wednesday that O'Neal has in fact informed him of his desire to return.

“Jermaine gave us a great lift near the end of the season, especially defensively,”

Danny Ainge on Jermaine O'Neal, Jun 1, 2011. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
Jermaine O'Neal, who sat out the second half of Monday's loss in Dallas with lingering left knee soreness, said it has showed no improvement the past two days.

Doc Rivers on Jermaine O'Neal, Nov 11, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.
